snippet.title: Vampire Knight DS English Trailer
snippet.description:
Vampire Knight DS is game for the Nintendo DS based on the anime/manga series of the same name. Originally only available in Japanese, this is a fully remastered version of the game's trailer, created for the release of the fan-made English translation patch. 

Find out more, and grab the download here: https://agtteam.net/vampire

Fancy getting involved with our mission to bring out more awesome anime games in English? Join our Discord server at: https://discord.com/invite/UUF7Zbm 

Original trailer available here:
https://youtu.be/qw4xX9oB1sI
